blocks.text: Thank you for accepting our offer

Dear {{candidate.first_name}}, we confirm that we received your acceptance of our offer for the position of {{employment.position_title}} on {{offer.accepted_at}}. A signed copy is available to you through the secure link you used to sign.

items: You will receive an invitation to our onboarding portal to complete your new starter details.

blocks.text: Your manager, {{employment.manager_name}}, will be in touch before your start date.
We will contact you about the remaining pre-employment checks.
Your start date is {{employment.start_date}}. If anything changes, contact {{employer.hr_contact_email}}.
